description: This file defines helper functions and type definitions related to the Ditto Protocol messages, including building messages, converting array buffers to strings, and handling external messages within a JavaScript project. It provides utilities for constructing protocol messages and managing payload conversions.

methods.name: buildDittoProtocolMsg(namespace, id, group, channel, criterion, action, path, dittoHeaders, value, status, extra)
methods.description: Constructs a Ditto Protocol message object with provided parameters.

methods.name: buildExternalMsg(headers, textPayload, bytePayload, contentType)
methods.description: Constructs an external message object with specified headers and payloads.

methods.name: arrayBufferToString(arrayBuffer)
methods.description: Converts an ArrayBuffer to a string by interpreting it as unsigned 8-bit integers.

methods.name: stringToArrayBuffer(string)
methods.description: Converts a string to an ArrayBuffer using unsigned 8-bit integers.

methods.name: asByteBuffer(arrayBuffer)
methods.description: Transforms an ArrayBuffer into a ByteBuffer, utilizing the bytebuffer.js library.
